22318929.kennel_description:
Esther Snow is a lovely middle-aged lady with a gentle spirit and a heart full of love, ready to find a home where she can settle in and be cherished for the rest of her days. She carries herself with a quiet dignity, the kind that comes from knowing exactly who she is—and what she wants most is a cozy spot, kind company, and a place to truly belong.

When Esther first arrived, she needed a little extra care due to some dental troubles. After getting the treatment she needed, she’s now feeling so much better—down to just two teeth, but honestly, she doesn’t mind one bit. Fewer teeth, fewer problems, right? She’s still able to enjoy both dry and wet food like a champ and doesn’t let it slow her down at all. She would, however, be safer in an indoor environment.

What Esther may lack in teeth, she more than makes up for in affection. She’s a sweet, loving companion who’s ready to form a strong bond with her person. She would do best in a calm, comfortable home where she can relax, feel safe, and soak up all the love she deserves.

If you’re looking for a loyal, low-key companion with a touch of charm and a whole lot of heart, Esther Snow is ready to spend her golden years right by your side.

22376105.kennel_description:
Meet Sheba, a truly stunning, big, solid black long-haired beauty with a majestic presence that's impossible to ignore. His luxurious coat and regal look turn heads, but it's his loving personality that will truly win your heart.

Sheba loves attention and will happily soak up all the pets you're willing to give. He's the perfect mix of elegant and affectionate, making him a wonderful companion for a calm and loving home. He is neutered and up to date on all vaccines, so he's ready to settle right into his forever family. If you're looking for a gorgeous, gentle soul to share your home with, Sheba is your guy.

22384313.kennel_description:
Meet Echo!

Echo is a sweet, social girl with a gentle voice and just the right amount to say. She’ll greet you with soft chatter and enjoys checking in throughout the day, especially when she’s looking for a little attention or company.

She loves being around people and would be happiest in a home where she can be part of the daily routine. Echo isn’t overly demanding—just a friendly, affectionate companion who likes to connect in her own quiet way.

If you’re looking for a loving cat with a touch of personality and charm, Echo could be the perfect fit!

22418172.kennel_description:
Meet Brownie

Brownie is the definition of sweet and gentle. This beautiful black kitty has the most stunning eyes — the kind that seem to look right into your heart. With her calm personality and loving nature, she’s happiest simply being close to her favorite person.

Brownie loves curling up beside her human for cozy naps, quiet evenings, and endless cuddles. She’s the type of cat who will softly lean in for little kisses and make every day feel warmer just by being there. Her peaceful presence makes her the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loyal best friend.

If you’re searching for a loving, affectionate cat with beauty and grace, Brownie is ready to fill your home with snuggles, kisses, and unconditional love.

22426816.kennel_description: Meet Sage ❤️ This beautiful girl has done an incredible job raising her kittens, and now it's finally her turn to be cared for and loved. Sage is a sweet, gentle girl who enjoys attention and would love a cozy spot to relax in the sun. If you're looking for a calm loving companion, Sage may be the perfect match for you.

22445930.kennel_description:
Meet Daphne

Daphne may not have had the easiest start in life, but you’d never guess it from the way she loves. This sweet kitten is all heart—affectionate, friendly, and ready to make friends the moment she meets you. Daphne is the kind of girl who jumps right into your lap (and your life) without hesitation.

Since arriving at the shelter, she’s been soaking up every bit of TLC and returning it tenfold. She’s playful, curious, and absolutely adores attention. Whether she’s chasing toys or snuggling in close for pets, Daphne is happiest when she’s with her people.

We’re also making sure Daphne feels her very best as she grows. She does have some dental disease, and she’ll be getting a dental procedure to help keep her healthy, comfortable, and ready for a bright future.

Daphne is looking for a home that will continue to shower her with the love she so freely gives. If you’re searching for a kitten who is equal parts cuddly, confident, and full of life, Daphne is ready to meet you.

All she needs now is a forever family to call her own

22504828.kennel_description: Meet Cherub! Cherub is a 14-year-old sweetheart. This chunky girl is as easygoing as they come and even does great for baths. Cherub enjoys the simple things in life- sleeping and a full bowl of food. She is looking for a calm home where she can spend her golden years being spoiled how she deserves.

22559149.kennel_description:
Meet Sue Ellen!

After spending the last eight weeks raising her babies, Sue Ellen is ready to find a forever home of her own. Rescued from a cat colony, this beautiful mostly white girl with a few black patches is still learning to trust people and takes a little time to warm up.

Sue Ellen is looking for a patient adopter and a quiet home where she can settle in at her own pace. We believe that with love, understanding, and patience, she will truly flourish and become a wonderful companion.

22568002.kennel_description: Meet Frances, a 1-year-old cat with a gentle heart and a calm personality. She loves quiet companionship, cozy spots to nap, and giving sweet purrs to her favorite people.

22583918.kennel_description: Fallon is a sweet little kitten who may be a bit shy when meeting new people, but with a little patience and understanding, she warms up quickly and lets her loving personality shine. She enjoys spending her days playing and cuddling with her siblings, and she takes comfort in having feline friends around. Because of this, we feel Fallon would thrive in a home with other cats where she can continue to build her confidence and enjoy companionship. Once she feels safe, Fallon is a playful, affectionate girl who will make a wonderful addition to the right family.

22593280.kennel_description:
Sweet Katydid has spent 12 long weeks growing up in the shelter, and now, at just 4 months old, he’s watching all of his siblings find their forever homes while he waits.
He is so ready for a family of his own. He deserves to know what it feels like to curl up in a cozy home, be someone’s baby, and be loved for the rest of his life.
Katydid has waited long enough. Could you be the forever family he’s been hoping for?

22618014.kennel_description: This sweet little one is full of curiosity, playful energy, and kitten charm. Like any young kitten, they're busy exploring the world, chasing toys, and enjoying plenty of naps in between. They're looking for a loving home where they can grow, play, and become a cherished member of the family.

22631272.kennel_description: After lovingly raising a litter of seven kittens, Fancy is finally ready to be the one getting all the attention. This incredibly sweet girl loves to lean in for pets and affection, happily soaking up every bit of love you have to offer. Now that her mama duties are done, Fancy is ready to find a forever home where she can be cherished, spoiled, and loved just as much as she deserves.

22631273.kennel_description: Meet Huck, a sweet and playful kitten with a curious nature and a heart full of love! She was one of 14 kittens who came into our care together, and after plenty of love and dedicated care, she grew into a happy, healthy little girl. Growing up with so many siblings has made Huck wonderfully social—she loves playing with other kittens, chasing toys, and curling up for cozy naps after a day of fun. Affectionate, confident, and full of personality, Huck is ready to find a forever home where she can continue to thrive and share her endless love.

22631275.kennel_description: Hollis is a lovable little girl with a gentle spirit and a playful heart. She enjoys exploring, chasing toys, and curling up for cozy naps after a day of kitten adventures. Sweet, curious, and full of charm, Hollis is ready to find a forever family to love and grow up with.

22631276.kennel_description: Howdy is a handsome little guy with a playful personality and a curious spirit. He loves exploring, chasing toys, and making new friends. After a day of kitten adventures, he's always ready to settle in for cuddles and purrs. Howdy is looking for a forever home where he can share a lifetime of love, fun, and companionship!

22637008.kennel_description: I am a very inquisitive, active and a cuddly ball of fur all rolled up in one! I’ll follow you wherever you go and I would like to participate in whatever you’re doing. I love to sneak up on and pounce and rumble with my playmates, Regina and Rhysand. I love to chase balls, feathers, socks and anything else that moves! I’ll play and play until I crawl onto your lap, tuckered out from play time, and will purr contentedly until my eyes slowly close and I drift off to sleep. I’ll wake up and do it all over again! If you’d like to take me home, please fill out an adoption application.

22652772.kennel_description: Meet Halo, a sweet and spirited kitten with a playful heart and a loving personality! She was one of 14 kittens who came into our care together, and thanks to lots of love and nurturing, she has grown into a happy, healthy little girl. Raised alongside so many siblings, Halo is incredibly well-socialized and loves spending her days playing, exploring, and snuggling with her feline friends. She has so much love to give and is ready to find a forever family that will treasure her for the wonderful kitten she is.

22652777.kennel_description: Ahoy! I'm Sailor, a 13-week-old first mate on the hunt for my forever crew. My specialties include chasing toy mice, purring through nap time, and bringing smiles wherever I go. I'm a sweet little guy with a gentle heart, curious whiskers, and plenty of love to share.

22652778.kennel_description:
Meet Milo

If you’re looking for a best friend with movie-star looks and the loudest, happiest purr you’ve ever heard, Milo is your guy. This gorgeous orange tabby turns heads everywhere he goes with his bright eyes, soft striped fur, and sweet little face that always looks like he’s smiling.

Milo is the kind of cat who will curl up beside you after a long day and start purring so loudly you’ll wonder if there’s a tiny engine hidden inside him. His purr is basically his love language. He adores attention, cozy naps, and being near his people whenever he can.

Playful, affectionate, and impossibly handsome, Milo is ready to bring warmth, cuddles, and nonstop charm into his forever home. All he’s missing is someone to love him as much as he’ll love them.

22659012.kennel_description:
Meet Gemma!

At just 4 months old, Gemma is a sweet little girl with her whole life ahead of her—and all she needs is a family to share it with!

Gemma is at the perfect age for playtime, cuddles, and learning all about the wonderful world outside the shelter. She’s ready for a cozy bed, a loving family, and a forever home where she can grow up feeling safe and cherished. ❤️

Every kitten deserves a family of their own, and Gemma is patiently waiting for hers. Could you be the one she’s been waiting for?

22668228.kennel_description: Meet a curious 5-month-old little gentleman with a big personality! This playful boy loves chasing toys, exploring every corner of the shelter, and turning ordinary moments into adventures. He's affectionate, full of energy, and always ready for cuddles after a busy day of zoomies. With his sweet nature and charming antics, he's sure to bring laughter and love to his forever home.

22668229.kennel_description: Meet a curious 5-month-old little gentleman with a big personality! This playful boy loves chasing toys, exploring every corner of the shelter, and turning ordinary moments into adventures. He's affectionate, full of energy, and always ready for cuddles after a busy day of zoomies. With his sweet nature and charming antics, he's sure to bring laughter and love to his forever home.

22673524.kennel_description: Finn is a 12-week-old tabby kitten looking for his forever home. He is sweet, playful, and curious, with a friendly personality that makes him a joy to be around. Finn enjoys playing with toys, exploring his surroundings, and curling up for a nap after a day of fun. He is ready to bring love and happiness to his new family.

22682304.kennel_description:
Pixie is a beautiful 2-year-old calico with a gentle heart. She can be a little shy and nervous when meeting new people or exploring new places, but with a little patience and kindness, her sweet personality begins to shine.

Once Pixie feels safe, she enjoys quiet companionship, cozy naps, and watching the world from her favorite sunny window. She's looking for a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace and build trust with her new family.

If you're willing to give her the time she needs, Pixie will reward you with quiet affection and the special bond that comes from earning the trust of a truly gentle soul.

22682305.kennel_description:
Beau may have a shorter coat than his fluffier brother, Arrow, but he's just as full of charm. This sweet boy is a little reserved at first, preferring to take in his surroundings before jumping into the fun. Once he's settled in, though, his playful side quickly comes to life.
Beau has a gentle, lovable personality that blossoms with patience and kindness. He's the kind of kitten who will reward your love with quiet companionship, playful antics, and plenty of sweet moments. If you've been thinking about adopting two kittens, Beau and Arrow are sure to bring double the laughter, double the entertainment, and double the love. Though we aren't requesting the two be adopted together.

22682306.kennel_description: Arrow is the fluffier of the two brothers, with a soft, slightly longer coat that makes him as handsome as he is sweet. While he can be a little shy when meeting new people, it doesn't take long for his playful personality to shine through. Once he feels comfortable, Arrow is an affectionate kitten who enjoys being part of the action and watching everything that's going on around him. If you're looking for a gentle, playful companion with a fluffy coat and an adorable personality, Arrow is ready to win you over. And if you're looking for double the fun, consider bringing home both brothers!

22682308.kennel_description: Ahoy! I'm Pirate! I'm the explorer of cardboard ships, conqueror of feather toys, and fearless hunter of shoelaces. ⚓ I am 11 weeks old and ready for my forever home!

22685175.kennel_description: Meet Hayes, a handsome tabby kitten with a curious spirit and a big heart! He loves to play, explore, and cuddle after a day of adventures. Hayes would love a home where he can grow up surrounded by love and plenty of fun.

22685176.kennel_description: Meet Helix, a sweet and playful little girl looking for her forever home! She thrives with other feline friends and would do best in a home with another cat to keep her company. If you're looking to add a loving kitten to your family, Helix is ready to curl up in your heart.

22685177.kennel_description: Handsome Hoyt is a striking tabby with a gentle personality. He likes to take a little time getting to know new people, but once he does, he's a sweet, affectionate companion who enjoys being by your side. Give him a chance, and Hoyt will quickly become a loyal best friend.

22685178.kennel_description: Meet Harvey, a handsome tabby kitten with a playful personality and an endless supply of charm! He loves chasing toys, exploring every corner, and soaking up attention. Harvey is ready to bring laughter, love, and plenty of purrs to his forever home.

22685179.kennel_description: Meet Hugo, a special little kitten with a playful spirit and a heart full of love! She was one of 14 kittens who came into our care at the same time, and with lots of love and dedication, she blossomed into the happy, healthy girl she is today. Growing up alongside so many other kittens has made Hugo incredibly social—she loves to chase toys, wrestle with her feline friends, and snuggle up when playtime is over. Sweet, curious, and always ready for her next adventure, Hugo is looking for a forever family that will give her the love she deserves.

22685180.kennel_description: Meet Harlo, a truly special little kitten with a heart as big as her personality! She was one of 14 kittens who came into our care at the same time, and thanks to lots of love and dedication, she grew into the happy, healthy girl she is today. That early experience surrounded by other kittens has made Harlo incredibly well-socialized—she loves to play, wrestle, and cuddle with her feline friends. Curious, affectionate, and full of fun, Harlo is ready to bring endless joy to a forever family that will cherish her as much as we have.

22685181.kennel_description: Meet Irelyn, an adorable black kitten with a bold personality! She arrived with her three other siblings, but she is easy to spot with her adorable little white patch on her chest that makes her extra special. This playful girl is full of energy, curiosity, and charm. She loves to explore, chase toys, and can turn just about anything into a game. Her outgoing personality is sure to keep you smiling, and she's always ready for her next adventure. Irelyn would thrive in a home with a feline friend or another playful companion to help burn off her kitten energy and keep her entertained. Whether it's another cat, one of her siblings, or a resident pet who enjoys kitten antics, she'd love having a buddy to share her days with. Much like her siblings, she is a tidy little lady who does a great job keeping her bedding and living space clean. If you're looking for a fun, affectionate kitten with a unique look and a big personality, she may be the perfect addition to your family!

22685182.kennel_description: Sweet little Irene is ready for her forever home! Though slightly smaller than her sister Irelyn, that does not slow her down. While she loves a good play session and can keep up with any kitten adventure, she also knows when it's time to slow down for cuddles and snuggles. Like her siblings, she thrives with a companion and would love a home with another playful cat or kitten to help build her confidence and share in all of life's adventures. She's a social kitten who enjoys having a friend to lean on. Don't let her cuddly side fool you though, she's still a ball of energy! Whether she's chasing toys, exploring her surroundings, or racing around with her playmate, she's always ready for fun. And at the end of the day, she'll be one of the first to greet you at the door, excited to welcome you home with her sweet and affectionate personality. If you're looking for a kitten who offers the perfect balance of playful energy and loving companionship, this little girl is ready to steal your heart.

22687939.kennel_description: Raven is a sweet, shy girl who can be a little skittish and needs some time to feel comfortable around new people.  She may be quiet and reserved at first, but with patience, kindness, and a calm environment, Raven can begin to build trust and show her gentle personality. She would love a patient person who understands that the best relationships take time. Once Raven feels safe, she has the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion.

22687944.kennel_description: Ahoy! Meet Captain, a charming little kitten ready to set sail for his forever home. This playful explorer is always searching for his next "treasure," whether it's a feather toy, a cozy blanket, or a sunny spot to nap. Captain is 11 weeks old.

22703742.kennel_description:
Meet Izzy!

Izzy is a sweet 10-week-old kitten who is full of curiosity and kitten energy. She loves exploring her surroundings, playing with toys, and discovering new things. Like any young kitten, Izzy is still learning and growing, but she is already showing her playful and affectionate personality.

With her adorable face and gentle nature, Izzy would make a wonderful addition to a loving home.

22703743.kennel_description:
Meet Iris

Iris is a tiny 10-week-old sweetheart and the adorable runt of her litter!  Don’t let her small size fool you—this little girl has a BIG personality packed into her teeny-tiny body.

Iris is curious, playful, and full of kitten energy. She may be the smallest of the bunch, but she’s always ready to keep up with her siblings, chase a toy, or find the coziest spot for a nap.
She’s proof that the tiniest paws can leave the biggest paw prints on your heart.

22709047.kennel_description: Meet Middie, a beautiful 2-year-old calico with a gentle heart and a loving spirit. This wonderful mama devoted herself to raising her two boys, Beau and Arrow, nursing and caring for them until they were old enough to start finding homes of their own. Now it's Middie's turn to be cared for. She is a sweet, affectionate cat who enjoys the company of people and is ready to trade the busy life of motherhood for one filled with comfort, cozy naps, and plenty of love. She has a calm, easygoing personality that makes her a wonderful companion for a family or someone looking for a loyal feline friend. Middie is scheduled to be spayed and will soon be ready to settle into the relaxing life she deserves. She'll happily spend her days lounging in a sunny window, accepting gentle pets, and keeping you company around the house. After giving so much love to her kittens, it's finally her time to be spoiled. If you're looking for a kind-hearted companion with a nurturing nature and lots of love to give, Middie is ready to make herself at home in your heart.

22709048.kennel_description:
Baby Dragon
Meet Baby Dragon, a gorgeous long-haired calico kitten with the sweetest little personality! She has a wonderfully unique meow that sounds more like a tiny whisper—which is exactly how she earned her magical name.

Baby Dragon is as adorable as she is special, with a fluffy coat and beautiful calico coloring that makes her impossible to resist.

If you're looking for a one-of-a-kind kitten with a soft voice, a big personality, and an unforgettable face, Baby Dragon may be your perfect match. She is in foster care so if you are interested in meeting her please fill out an application and we will coordinate a time with the foster.

22711684.kennel_description: Meet Weevil! This adorable long-haired orange kitten is a little shy at first, but his sweet nature and fluffy charm are impossible to resist. With a little patience and love, Weevil is sure to blossom into a wonderful companion.

22722874.kennel_description: Meet Merlin, a handsome little boy with a name fit for a magical legend! Merlin was one of seven kittens raised by his devoted mama, Mystical. Merlin is a charming little fellow with a curious mind and a playful heart. Like any good wizard, he’s always ready to investigate his surroundings, discover something new, and perhaps create a little harmless kitten mischief along the way! He has a sweet disposition and a wonderful blend of confidence, curiosity, and affection. There is something extra special about a kitten named Merlin. Come meet this sweet boy and see for yourself!

22722875.kennel_description: Whimsy is a sweet little girl who came in with her seven siblings and mama, Mystical. This girl is full of charm and has a delightful, playful spirit. Whimsy is curious about the world around her and seems to find a little bit of magic wherever she goes. She has a gentle nature, a bright personality, and that special kitten energy that can turn even the simplest moment into an adventure. With her whimsical name and sweet personality, Whimsy is sure to bring a little extra joy into her forever home. She’s ready to leave her kitten days behind and begin a magical new chapter with a family of her very own

22722877.kennel_description:
Meet Kratos

This big orange boy is around 3–5 years old and has the cutest ears you’ve ever seen!  Kratos is a total sweetheart who loves affection and would happily soak up all the love and attention you’re willing to give. He’s a big, lovable cuddle bug with an even bigger heart.

If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion, Kratos may be your perfect match!

22725535.kennel_description: Persimmon is a gorgeous grey girl with a soft coat and an equally sweet personality! She came in with her littermates and loves having the companionship of other kittens around her. This pretty girl is curious, playful, and full of kitten energy. Persimmons is ready to find her forever family and fill their home with plenty of purrs, playtime, and kitten sweetness

22725536.kennel_description: Meet Plum, a beautiful all-black girl with hidden patches of white and sweet personality and a love for companionship! Plum came to us with her littermates and absolutely enjoys having a friend by her side. Plum is playful, affectionate, and full of adorable kitten charm. Her sleek black coat and sweet personality make her a wonderful little addition to any loving family.

22728046.kennel_description: Meet Mystical, a beautiful mama cat with a heart as magical as her name. Mystical came into our care with seven precious kittens, and from the very beginning, she proved what an incredible mother she was. Nurturing, patient, and loving, she devoted herself completely to her babies and was the perfect mama to her little family. Now that her kittens are growing up, Mystical is ready for a new chapter of her own. Although she is a wonderful grown-up mama, she still has a little bit of kitten left in her! When she plays, that playful side comes shining through, reminding everyone that even the best moms deserve some time to have fun. Mystical is patiently waiting for someone to see just how special she is. She has given so much love to her seven babies, and now it’s her turn to be someone’s beloved forever cat. If you’re looking for a gentle, nurturing companion with a touch of playful magic, Mystical may be the one you’ve been waiting for.

22728047.kennel_description:
Hi I'm Phantom!
I'm a 11-week-old black kitten with a curious heart and a playful spirit. I love chasing feather toys, exploring every corner, and snuggling up after a fun day of adventures. I'm looking for a forever family to share all my purrs with.

22728048.kennel_description:
Hi I'm Gypsy!
I'm a 11-week-old black kitten with a curious heart and a playful spirit. I love chasing feather toys, exploring every corner, and snuggling up after a fun day of adventures. I'm looking for a forever family to share all my purrs with.

22728049.kennel_description: Hi I'm Potter! I'm a 11-week-old tuxedo kitten with a curious heart and a playful spirit. I love chasing feather toys, exploring every corner, and snuggling up after a fun day of adventures. I'm looking for a forever family to share all my purrs with.

22728050.kennel_description: Say hello to Pineapple, a handsome all-black boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for companionship! Pineapple came to us with his littermates and loves having other kittens around. Pineapple is a fun-loving, social kitten who is sure to bring plenty of personality and joy to his new home. He’s at the perfect age to keep his family entertained with playful kitten antics while also enjoying plenty of affection and snuggles. He would be happiest in a home with a loving family

22730314.kennel_description: Meet Sawyer, the fluffiest little explorer you'll ever meet!  With a cloud-soft coat, endless curiosity, and an adorable face that's impossible to resist, Sawyer turns every corner into an adventure. Whether he's chasing toys, investigating mysterious boxes, or curling up for a cozy nap, this sweet kitten brings joy wherever he goes. Cute, cuddly, and always ready to discover something new, Sawyer is proof that the best adventures come in tiny, fluffy packages.

22730315.kennel_description: Olivia is a 12-week-old tabby kitten looking for her forever home. She is sweet, playful, and curious, with a friendly personality that makes her a joy to be around. Olivia enjoys playing with toys, exploring her surroundings, and curling up for a nap after a day of fun. She is ready to bring love and happiness to her new family.

22734218.kennel_description: Faye is a gentle and thoughtful little kitten who prefers to take her time getting to know new people and surroundings. While she can be a bit shy at first, her sweet personality begins to shine once she feels safe and comfortable. With patience and a calm environment, Faye blossoms into a loving companion who enjoys quiet affection and playful moments with her siblings. She takes comfort in the company of other cats, and we believe she would thrive in a home with a feline friend to help her continue building confidence. Faye may not be the first kitten to greet you at the door, but earning her trust is incredibly rewarding, and her loving nature makes every moment worthwhile.

22734219.kennel_description: Beezus is a striking tabby girl with beautiful white patches that make her impossible to overlook.  She has a one-of-a-kind look that perfectly matches her charming personality. Beezus may be a little shy when meeting new people, but with a little patience, her sweet and affectionate nature quickly shines through. She is a little ball of love who enjoys playtime just as much as she enjoys curling up for a cozy nap after a day of kitten adventures. If you're looking for a one-of-a-kind kitten with a gentle heart and lots of love to give, Beezus is ready to find her forever family.
